source: We are making a game called Piggy Chomp. The game is 3D. There is a crocodile in the middle of a lake. You can shoot little cute piggies at the crocodile. If the piggy touches the crocodile, you get points. Basically The game is like a slingshot with piggies

image_prompt.text: A large crocodile sitting in the middle of a lake, the target everything is aimed at
A slingshot on the near bank, oriented across the water toward the crocodile, with clear space behind it to stand
A lake wide enough that the shot has to be aimed, with banks framing it on the player's side

layout_placement.text: A detection region on the crocodile that registers a point when a piggy touches it

notes: No preset was taken. The two continuous-space presets are hide-and-seek and quiz, and both would have added cover clutter or an answer grid that fight the prompt. Tuned from scratch instead.
Not one image option in the loaded file matched anything in this prompt - the slingshot, the crocodile and the lake are all free text.
The player may never move from the slingshot. Stage B was answered yes on the tie-break rule, because the lake and the target are a real space to build even if the avatar stands still.

open_questions.ask: Is there a target score, a timer, or a piggy count per run - or is it endless?
Does the player walk around the lake, or stay fixed at one slingshot?
How far is the crocodile from the slingshot? That distance is the whole difficulty curve

theme: Stylized / Toon - cute, bright, oversized props

coverage_missing.ask: What ends a run - a score target, a timer, running out of piggies?
One fixed slingshot position, or several around the lake?
Single player, or several players slinging at the same crocodile?

answers.ask: Is there a target score, a timer, or a piggy count per run - or is it endless?
answers.answer: Make it endless score-chasing with no timer or target score; players keep launching piggies and earning points.

answers.ask: Does the player walk around the lake, or stay fixed at one slingshot?
answers.answer: The player stays at one fixed slingshot on the lake shore, aimed toward the crocodile.

answers.ask: How far is the crocodile from the slingshot? That distance is the whole difficulty curve
answers.answer: Place the crocodile a short-to-medium distance away across the lake, roughly 35 studs from the slingshot, so launches are easy to understand but still need aim.
